Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained. The Academy of Performing Arts of the University of Sarajevo, the main public institution in the field, was checked department by department: acting opened in 1981, directing in 1989, dramaturgy in 1994, production and management in 2010, audiovisual arts in 2016. No puppetry department. The country does have institutional puppetry activity, the Mostar puppet theatre running an international festival of the form, but production is not training and does not stand in for it in this indicator. Upper bound raised from 0 to 1: the arts academy of Banja Luka was not checked. Estimate, resting on search summaries.

DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90. To be redone in full once the denominator is settled.
